environment.frequency_control: governor recorded; frequency and turbo are not fixed

child_environment.PATH: inherited for executable lookup; all other variables omitted

method.randomization: shuffle workloads each round; shuffle five endpoints within each workload
method.pairing: one sample for every endpoint per workload and round
method.bootstrap: resample complete paired rounds; ratio of medians; reselect fastest C median in each draw
method.intervals: per comparison; no simultaneous coverage claim
method.timing: perf_counter_ns around process launch and completion, including fresh process startup and wait
method.stdout: DEVNULL for every timed command; -S has no -o argument
method.warmup: one discarded timed run per command after build and preflight
method.cpu_affinity: controller and all compiler descendants pinned to one logical CPU
method.excluded: installed compiler/stage preparation, input generation, preflight, and final assembling/linking
method.scope: ordinary generated functions and the direct intrusive witness; no SQLite, self-host, or checked-language speed claim
method.handoff: --prepare retains source AST operations and is not full backend handoff; full assembly is a conservative upper bound that includes lowering and emission

endpoints.gcc-syntax: GCC C99 parsing and semantic checks; -fsyntax-only
endpoints.clang-syntax: Clang C99 parsing and semantic checks; -fsyntax-only
endpoints.rmd-check: RMD reader, declaration collection, type resolution, body checking
endpoints.rmd-prepare: RMD check plus native link validation and frame/value planning; source AST operations remain
endpoints.rmd-assembly: RMD check, preparation, lowering, and complete textual assembly emitted to stdout; stdout goes to DEVNULL
